_comment: Lines in paper/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md that cite numbers no artifact under artifacts/ produces.
tests/test_provenance.py fails on any untraced number NOT listed here, so this file is a
ratchet: a newly written number without an artifact turns the build red, while the audited
existing set stays visible rather than being deleted from the notebook.
Groups are by reason, and the reason is the justification. A new entry needs one.
'genuine_provenance_gap' is a real hole, not an accepted exemption - see the M3 entry.

identifier_in_prose.reason: Utterance and collection identifiers quoted as examples (e.g. 5572615, 25328). Not measurements.

machine_state_at_time_of_run.reason: Transient machine state recorded for reproducibility: swap usage, core clock under load, governor. True of that run, unrepeatable by nature.

superseded_interim_run.reason: Chronological lab-notebook entries from M0/M1/M2 runs later superseded by the final gated numbers. A notebook is supposed to contain these; the current values are the ones CLAIMS_LEDGER.md and the gated artifact sections carry.

genuine_provenance_gap.reason: A real hole. The M3 duration-controlled analysis (the negation/head-shake r=0.554 headline) is in the log but no artifact stores it - the analysis was run interactively and never persisted. 'linguistic accuracy 0.809' is quoted from a design document, not measured here. All need a script that writes an artifact; none is an acceptable steady state. The 89.5%/10.5% alignment figures were also here until 2026-09-29, when scripts/check_asllrp_alignment.py made them reproducible and the entry was removed.
